subject: GTE
body: Which body licenses teachers in Ghana?
explanation: The NTC conducts the GTLE and issues professional teaching licences.

subject: GTE
body: Which body develops Ghana's pre-tertiary curriculum?
explanation: The National Council for Curriculum and Assessment.

subject: GTE
body: The Ghana Education Service is mainly responsible for
explanation: NTC licenses, WAEC sets the BECE and NaCCA designs the curriculum.

subject: GTE
body: Which law established Ghana's education regulatory bodies, including the NTC?
explanation: The Education Regulatory Bodies Act, 2020. Act 778 is the Education Act; Act 506 the GES Act; Act 1049 the Pre-Tertiary Education Act.

subject: GTE
body: Passing the GTLE is required for
explanation: Licensed teachers can then be recruited into GES.

subject: GTE
body: A professional teaching licence in Ghana must be renewed
explanation: Renewal is linked to continuing professional development.

subject: GTE
body: Ghana's National Teachers' Standards cover
explanation: Professional values and attitudes, professional knowledge and professional practice.

subject: GTE
body: Punctuality and professional dress fall under
explanation: One of the three domains of the standards.

subject: GTE
body: Continuous professional development means
explanation: Workshops, mentoring, courses and reflection.

subject: GTE
body: Reflective practice means
options: reviewing your teaching to improve it
explanation: Ask what worked, what didn't and why.

subject: GTE
body: Ghana's standards-based curriculum for KG to B6 was introduced in
explanation: It emphasises core competencies and learner-centred teaching.

subject: GTE
body: Under the current structure, JHS covers
explanation: KG1–KG2, B1–B6, then JHS B7–B9.

subject: GTE
body: The examination taken at the end of JHS is the
explanation: WASSCE is taken at the end of SHS.

subject: GTE
body: Free SHS was introduced in Ghana in
explanation: It removed fees for public senior high school.

subject: GTE
body: From KG to B3, the main medium of instruction is
explanation: English is taught as a subject and takes over gradually.

subject: GTE
body: Core competencies in the curriculum include
options: memorising facts as fast as possible
copying notes neatly from the board
explanation: Also creativity, communication, collaboration and digital literacy.

subject: GTE
body: A scheme of work is
options: a term's plan of topics to teach
explanation: Lesson notes break it into individual lessons.

subject: GTE
body: 'Relevant previous knowledge' in a lesson note means
explanation: Build new learning on it.

subject: GTE
body: TLMs stands for
explanation: Charts, objects, models and digital resources.

subject: GTE
body: Which approach is learner-centred?
explanation: Learners actively build understanding.

subject: GTE
body: Gender-responsive teaching means
options: seating all girls at the back
calling mostly on boys to answer
giving boys and girls equal chances
explanation: Equal participation, expectations and roles.

subject: GTE
body: Learners with special educational needs should usually be
options: kept at home until they improve
taught in regular classes with support
explanation: Inclusive education.

subject: GTE
body: A good use of a projector in class is to
options: replace all teacher talk with slides
play films for the whole lesson
explanation: Technology should support learning goals.

subject: GTE
body: Which is an example of formative assessment?
explanation: It checks understanding during learning.

subject: GTE
body: Assessment OF learning is
explanation: Assessment FOR learning is formative; AS learning is self-assessment.

subject: GTE
body: The best way to manage behaviour from day one is to
explanation: Agree rules and routines with learners.

subject: GTE
body: A learner keeps failing to do homework. The best first step is to
options: find out why from the learner
explanation: There may be a reason at home or a learning gap.

subject: GTE
body: GES discipline policy promotes
explanation: Positive discipline guides behaviour without violence.

subject: GTE
body: A sexual relationship between a teacher and a pupil is
explanation: It's a serious breach of the code of conduct and the law.

subject: GTE
body: Ghana's main law on children's rights is
explanation: It protects children's welfare and rights.
